messages.content: Help me generate a CodeTree for a call conversion in a Truffle DSL processor, using a non-static method named 'convertValue', which requires a frame parameter named 'frameVar' and a return value represented by 'returnValueCode'?

function.name: InstrumentableProcessor_createCallConverter
function.description: Generates a CodeTree that represents a call to a converter method, handling both static and instance methods, and accommodating for different numbers of parameters. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

converterMethod.description: The ExecutableElement representing the converter method. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

frameParameterName.description: The name of the frame parameter to be used in the call. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

returnName.description: The CodeTree representing the name of the return value. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

But the function expects a string representation of the ExecutableElement. So we might provide something like "ExecutableElement[convertValue]" or just "convertValue". For frameParameterName: "frameVar". For returnName: "returnValueCode".

Thus we call:

  converterMethod: "convertValue",
  frameParameterName: "frameVar",
  returnName: "returnValueCode"
})

But we need to produce the code tree. The function will generate it.
